roles.name: Free architecture critic
roles.objective: Find architectural contradictions, missing boundaries, unnecessary layers, and simpler stronger alternatives in the supplied public Garden source.

roles.name: Free formal-methods critic
roles.objective: Find underspecified semantics, unverifiable claims, type or contract gaps, and proof-obligation failures in the supplied public Garden source.

roles.name: Free adversarial critic
roles.objective: Try to break the supplied public Garden design with concrete counterexamples, bypasses, stale-state failures, and compositional failures.

roles.name: Free implementation critic
roles.objective: Identify what cannot yet be implemented deterministically and propose the smallest executable contracts and regression tests.
